The cherry blossoms have swept northward, wisteria drips in heavy purple curtains, fresh green leaves blanket the mountains, and the entire country hums with an almost electric sense of renewal. But here’s the reality that catches many visitors off guard: Golden Week, the cluster of national holidays running from late April to early May, is Japan’s busiest domestic travel period — bar none.
